title: Accumulate SSE data lines before JSON decode (tool calling + streaming)
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Fixes JSONDecodeError in Python streaming chat when tool_call payloads contain embedded newlines and are emitted as multiline SSE `data:` entries. Prior code attempted JSON.parse per line. This PR accumulates all `data:` lines for an event, joins per SSE spec, then decodes once. Adds fixtures for tool_call frames and ensures backward compatibility with single-line events.
commits: sdk/python: accumulate SSE data lines per event
